name: OpenClaw Direct
postCreateCommand: sudo npm install -g openclaw@latest && mkdir -p /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data && ln -sfn /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data ~/.openclaw
postStartCommand: export $(grep -v '^#' .env 2>/dev/null | xargs) || echo '⚠️ No .env found, skipping auto-export.'
echo '👋 Welcome! If this is your first time: 1. Rename .env.example to .env 2. Run: openclaw onboard'
